spans.s:
aṅká, m.
 —1. the bend at the groin made
by taking a sitting position, lap;
 —2. the
bend just above the hip (where babes, sitting
astride, are carried by Hindu women
--see āroha);
 —3. hook;
 —4. (like Eng.
pot-hook) mark, sign. [√añc: for 1, cf.
ἀγκών, ‘bend in arm or wall or shore’; for
[]
3, cf. ὄγκος, Lat. uncus, AS. ongel, ‘hook’;
cf. Eng. angle, not a borrowed word.]
